content: Saga/compensation frameworks: a saga is a sequence of local transactions, each paired with an optional compensating transaction; on failure, compensations run in reverse order. Eventuate Tram Sagas (Java/Spring): saga orchestration built on transactional outbox messaging (atomic DB update + message publish without JTA). Axon Framework: saga modeled via CQRS/event-sourcing -- saga instances are event-driven, correlated to events by property, with separate event handlers for invocation vs compensation. These are heavyweight, message-bus/event-sourcing-centric frameworks requiring substantial infrastructure and architectural buy-in -- reinforces why entflow defers compensation past MVP rather than building a full saga-orchestration subsystem.
